summary: Frontend regression for two fixes: (1) Doogie chat error surfacing when Emergent LLM key hits daily budget, and (2) mobile input font-size >= 16px to prevent iOS auto-zoom. Both fixes VERIFIED. All 4 test scenarios PASS. LLM daily-cap is still active (out-of-scope), and the client-side fallback now correctly renders the friendly 'Woof — Doogie's brain is temporarily unavailable' bubble instead of an empty one. Mobile inputs now compute to exactly 16px on all sampled selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is still ~1482 lines — carried over from iteration_5/6. Refactor into pages/components/forms/legal modules for maintainability. Not a functional issue.
BCFSA licence number is still literal placeholder '[Doug to add]' at data-testid=licence-num — must be filled in before production launch to satisfy BCFSA advertising rules (carried over).

DoogieChat.send() sets gotAnyContent=true inside the j.error branch and then overwrites the bubble with a fallback each frame — if the backend ever sends multiple SSE data frames containing 'error', the last one wins (acceptable but could be defensive: break out of the loop after first error). Non-blocking.

The 'catch' clause on line 139 catches network-level failures and renders 'Woof — I had trouble connecting.' but leaves busy=false only after — currently correct but no timeout guard: if fetch never completes, the send button stays disabled indefinitely. Consider an AbortController with a 30s timeout. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: n/a — all tests are public frontend
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_6 outstanding items are now closed: mobile-form auto-zoom prevention verified (buyer-name/email/phone/type + hero-search-input all compute to 16px at 390x844), and Doogie error resilience verified (assistant bubble now contains 'Woof — Doogie's brain is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment, or ask Doug directly via the Contact page. (Reason: Failed to start streaming completion: litellm.APIError: APIError: OpenAIException - Daily spend limit reached)' — 242 chars, non-empty). The Emergent LLM key is STILL over daily budget at time of testing — user must top up via Emergent Profile → Universal Key → Add Balance to restore real Doogie answers. Consent modal, panel-close via ×, hamburger drawer open/close, no horizontal overflow, and cookie-banner-stacked-above-FAB all still pass.

test1_doogie_error_surfacing_desktop_144.fallback_text_matches_expected: PASS — starts with 'Woof — Doogie's brain is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment, or ask Doug directly via the Contact page. (Reason: ...Daily spend limit reached)'

test3_mobile_regression_390x844.cookie_banner_above_doogie_fab: PASS (banner bottom y=756, FAB top y=762 — no overlap)

rca_of_the_issue.prior_bug_1: Empty Doogie bubble on error — RESOLVED. The frontend now parses SSE 'error' frames in DoogieChat.send() (App.js line 134) and swaps in a friendly fallback. A second guard (line 138) replaces any empty final bubble with 'Woof — I didn't receive a response...'. Verified live against real backend which is still returning 'Daily spend limit reached'.
rca_of_the_issue.prior_bug_2: Mobile inputs 15.2px causing iOS auto-zoom — RESOLVED. New CSS rule at /app/frontend/src/index.css:206 `.field input, .field select, .field textarea, .search-bar input, .doogie-panel form input { font-size: 16px }` inside the existing @media(max-width:700px) block wins on specificity+cascade order. Verified computed style = 16px on all sampled selectors.
